prompts.ui_bar_frame:
Hand-painted semi-realistic HD isometric game art, like the best classic 2D castle city-builders:
soft painterly shading, rich natural material texture, warm late-summer light from the upper left,
soft shadow to the lower right, tallgrass prairie, lake and oak woodland palette, no outlines,
no text.
A thin carved wooden frame for a horizontal bar, seen straight on, even light, plain flat #00FF00 background, no text, no symbols. A single straight rectangular smooth grey-brown peeled wood frame, 8:3 outer aspect ratio, thin straight rails and simple slightly rounded carved corners. Empty clean green opening through the frame from edge to edge inside, exactly the same green as the outside. Warm tanned ochre-brown material, restrained soft highlights, no metal or decoration, perfectly level symmetrical presentation, ample background margin around it. The texture will be reduced to 64 by 24 px with 8 px corner slices; keep rails thin and central edges uninterrupted.
prompts.ui_bar_fill: Drawn from SPEC.md section 10: neutral #E6E6E6 with soft shading, 8×16, tinted in the game.

A single small round painted game badge: a plain unpainted tipi beside a small central fire under a crescent of dusk sky, in tanned hide and warm firelight colours. Plain rounded hide rim, warm pale log-tan base and subtle blue-grey crescent sky. Distinct legible tipi and fire silhouettes at small sizes. No words, logos, letters, real symbols, or sacred objects. Flat solid #00FF00 outside the clean round rim, no external cast shadow, centered, fills 82 percent of the square, equal margins.
